header.name: Data Science
header.description: Data science is an interdisciplinary subject interface with computer science, statistics, and machine learning. This course will enable students to manage large data and perform data analysis using statistical methods and sketching techniques. They will learn to use various learning models to discover and interpret intrinsic patterns in data of various types. They will also learn to handle large data sets, data coming in a streaming fashion and perform data analysis.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to perform exploratory analysis of multivariate data and scientific data visualisation

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to per perform predictive analysis and statistical hypothesis testing.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to work with streaming data, give probabilistic bounds on the algorithmic claims

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will build capability of real life problem solving and dealing with large data.
